title: New and simplified method for drug combination studies by checkerboard assay
author: Bellio, Fagnani, et al.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Weigh the required amount of powdered medium, dissolve in deionised water to obtain 10 mL of MHB and 50–100 mL of 2 × CAMHB, then autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Prepare sterile saline (0.9% NaCl)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.9 g NaCl in 100 mL deionised water, stir with a magnetic stirrer, and autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Make drug stock solutions
steps.instruction: Weigh the appropriate amount of drug A and drug B powders and dissolve each in the solvent recommended by CLSI or EUCAST (or the most stable solvent listed in the datasheet).

steps.title: Prepare microbial inoculum
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony from a nutrient agar plate with a sterile loop, inoculate into 10 mL MHB, and incubate at 35 ± 2 °C, 200 rpm, for 18 ± 2 h; the culture will reach ~10⁹ CFU/mL.

steps.title: Dispense base medium into plate
steps.instruction: Place 100 µL of 2 × CAMHB into a V‑shaped reservoir (or sterile Petri dish) and dispense into every well of a 96‑well microplate using a multichannel pipette, moving column‑wise.

steps.title: Prepare and add drug A solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 mL of stock solution SA in 2 × CAMHB (4‑fold higher than the highest test concentration) and 500 µL of 2 × SA in 2 × CAMHB (8‑fold higher). Dispense 100 µL of SA into row A, columns 1–11, and 100 µL of 2 × SA into well A12 to keep drug A concentration constant during subsequent dilutions.

steps.title: Prepare and add drug B solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.0 mL of stock solution SB in 2 × CAMHB (4‑fold higher than the highest test concentration) and dispense 100 µL of SB into each well of column 12.

steps.title: Incubate checkerboard plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with its cover (optional sealing film if volume variation is expected) and place in a static incubator at 35 ± 2 °C for 18 ± 2 h; optionally add a water tray to minimise evaporation.

steps.title: Mix and read optical density
steps.instruction: After incubation, mix the contents of all wells with a multichannel pipette, insert the plate into a microplate reader, and record OD at 600 nm (or 595/605 nm).

steps.title: Calculate percent growth
steps.instruction: For each well compute % growth = (OD_drug‑combination – OD_background) / (OD_drug‑free – OD_background) × 100, using the background OD measured from wells without bacterial growth.

steps.title: Determine MIC values
steps.instruction: Identify the lowest concentration of each drug (or combination) that reduces bacterial growth by >80 % relative to the drug‑free control; this is the MIC for that condition.
